policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Bangladesh visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Current Irish DFA guidance expressly says Bangladesh’s visa-on-arrival system is available to Irish travellers, subject to visit purpose.
conditions: The DFA says availability depends on the purpose of visit and recommends advance acquisition to avoid uncertainty; this records the expressly available short-visitor arrival route only.
Purpose, supporting documents, entry point, border decision, security, health and final admission remain applicable.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic short-stay visa
policies.summary: Burkina Faso’s current embassy guidance makes its online short-stay process and emailed EVISA document available to any person seeking a short-entry visa.
conditions: The stated short-stay route covers one to 90 days. Applicants apply online and, if accepted, receive the EVISA document by email for presentation at the border.
This excludes long stay, work, residence, transit-specific, diplomatic and special-document routes, and does not guarantee admission.

application.label: Visa Burkina electronic entry-visa service
steps: Apply online for the intended short-stay visa.
If accepted, present the emailed EVISA document at entry.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire airport-issued visitor visa
policies.summary: Côte d’Ivoire’s current official ordinary-passport process requires online pre-enrolment, but the visa itself is printed and issued at Abidjan airport after biometric enrolment.
conditions: The official process is limited to valid ordinary passports and requires approved online pre-enrolment, payment, travel documents and airport biometric enrolment before the visa is printed and delivered.
The electronic application and approved document are not electronic issuance; the normal visitor visa is issued at the airport. Final admission and all published requirements remain applicable.

application.label: Côte d’Ivoire official SNEDAI pre-enrolment
steps: Complete online pre-enrolment and payment for the ordinary-passport visitor visa.
Carry the approved pre-enrolment document to Abidjan airport.
Complete biometrics at the airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: Jordan airport-issued tourist visa
policies.summary: Current Irish DFA guidance says Irish tourists can purchase Jordan’s visitor visa on arrival at the named airports.
conditions: The stated arrival route is Queen Alia International Airport or Aqaba Airport, costs 40 Jordanian dinars, and is valid for one month with possible extension.
Work, study, non-tourist travel, other crossings, online routes, registration for longer non-tourist stays and final admission remain separate.
